**Job Description:**  

Job Description
  
  

Role Purpose
  
  

The purpose of this role is to design, test and maintain software programs for operating systems or applications which needs to be deployed at a client end and ensure its meet 100% quality assurance parameters
  
  

͏
  
  

Do
  
  

1\. Instrumental in understanding the requirements and design of the product/ software
  
  

Develop software solutions by studying information needs, studying systems flow, data usage and work processes
  
Investigating problem areas followed by the software development life cycle
  
Facilitate root cause analysis of the system issues and problem statement
  
Identify ideas to improve system performance and impact availability
  
Analyze client requirements and convert requirements to feasible design
  
Collaborate with functional teams or systems analysts who carry out the detailed investigation into software requirements
  
Conferring with project managers to obtain information on software capabilities
  
͏
  
  

2\. Perform coding and ensure optimal software/ module development
  
  

Determine operational feasibility by evaluating analysis, problem definition, requirements, software development and proposed software
  
Develop and automate processes for software validation by setting up and designing test cases/scenarios/usage cases, and executing these cases
  
Modifying software to fix errors, adapt it to new hardware, improve its performance, or upgrade interfaces.
  
Analyzing information to recommend and plan the installation of new systems or modifications of an existing system
  
Ensuring that code is error free or has no bugs and test failure
  
Preparing reports on programming project specifications, activities and status
  
Ensure all the codes are raised as per the norm defined for project / program / account with clear description and replication patterns
  
Compile timely, comprehensive and accurate documentation and reports as requested
  
Coordinating with the team on daily project status and progress and documenting it
  
Providing feedback on usability and serviceability, trace the result to quality risk and report it to concerned stakeholders
  
͏
  
  

3\. Status Reporting and Customer Focus on an ongoing basis with respect to project and its execution

Participating in continuing education and training to remain current on best practices, learn new programming languages, and better assist other team members.
  
Consulting with engineering staff to evaluate software\-hardware interfaces and develop specifications and performance requirements
  
Document and demonstrate solutions by developing documentation, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments and clear code
  
Documenting very necessary details and reports in a formal way for proper understanding of software from client proposal to implementation
  
Ensure good quality of interaction with customer w.r.t. e\-mail content, fault report tracking, voice calls, business etiquette etc
  
Timely Response to customer requests and no instances of complaints either internally or externally
  
͏

No. Performance Parameter Measure
  
1\. Continuous Integration, Deployment \& Monitoring of Software 100% error free on boarding \& implementation, throughput %, Adherence to the schedule/ release plan
  
2\. Quality \& CSAT On\-Time Delivery, Manage software, Troubleshoot queries, Customer experience, completion of assigned certifications for skill upgradation

jobs.description:
**Job Requirements**  

  

**Job Description: Store Manager / Boutique Head – Zoya**
---------------------------------------------------------

  

  

### **Role Purpose**


The Store Manager / Boutique Head will be responsible for managing the overall performance of the Zoya boutique. The role includes driving sales, ensuring smooth store operations, managing customer experience, leading the store team, maintaining compliance, and achieving business targets related to sales, profitability and customer satisfaction.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **1\. Sales \& Business Performance**


* Drive store sales and ensure achievement of monthly, quarterly and annual business targets.
* Monitor sales performance regularly and take corrective actions wherever required.
* Provide inputs for annual business planning and store\-level sales targets.
* Track store profitability, revenue growth and ROI.
* Review sales data and identify opportunities to improve performance.

### **2\. Store Operations**


* Ensure smooth day\-to\-day functioning of the boutique.
* Maintain store standards as per company guidelines.
* Ensure proper staffing, duty allocation and target setting for store team members.
* Monitor stock levels, replenishment, product mix and ageing stock.
* Ensure old gold purchase, stock tallying and inventory processes are followed as per policy.
* Coordinate with internal teams such as VM, merchandising, admin, IRSG, finance and regional teams.

### **3\. Customer Experience**


* Ensure a premium and consistent customer experience in line with Zoya’s luxury positioning.
* Manage customer queries and complaints as per company guidelines.
* Build relationships with key, regular and high\-value customers.
* Drive customer engagement initiatives such as birthdays, anniversaries, dormancy drives and customer meets.
* Capture and share customer feedback with relevant corporate and regional teams.

### **4\. Retail Marketing \& Schemes**


* Support the planning and execution of annual retail marketing activities.
* Work with ABM / regional teams for BTL activities, promotions, VM updates and customer engagement initiatives.
* Ensure timely rollout of national and regional schemes at the store level.
* Drive awareness and implementation of schemes such as Golden Harvest as per company policy.

### **5\. Compliance \& Process Adherence**


* Ensure adherence to company policies, processes and code of conduct.
* Monitor attendance, grooming, leave, confidentiality, dress code and discipline within the store.
* Ensure all commercial and financial records are maintained accurately.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory and internal audit requirements.
* Minimize cases of non\-compliance through regular monitoring and review.

### **6\. Team Management \& Development**


* Lead, guide and motivate the store team to deliver business and customer goals.
* Drive a culture of performance, transparency and ownership.
* Conduct training need analysis and nominate team members for relevant training programs.
* Support retraining on new systems, policies and processes.
* Mentor team members and build a strong talent pipeline for critical roles.

### **7\. Recruitment \& People Practices**


* Support hiring of store staff in coordination with HR and regional teams.
* Participate in interviews and selection discussions.
* Ensure team engagement, diversity and integration within the boutique.
* Support succession planning for key store roles.

**Internal Stakeholders**
-------------------------


* Regional teams
* IRSG team
* Visual Merchandising team
* Merchandising team
* Finance team
* HR team
* Admin team
* Retail Operations team
* Marketing team

**External Stakeholders**
-------------------------


* Key customers
* Government officials / regulatory authorities
* Vendors and service partners, wherever applicable
  

  

  

  

**Work Experience**  

**Education: Graduate**
-----------------------

  

  

**Experience**
--------------


13–15 years of overall experience, with at least 5–6 years in a similar leadership role in a luxury retail brand.

  

  

**Required Knowledge**
----------------------


* Sales and retail operations
* Luxury customer handling
* Store profitability and business planning
* Inventory and stock management
* Stakeholder management
* Retail marketing and scheme implementation
* Compliance and process management
  

  

**Key Behavioural Skills**
--------------------------


* Customer centricity
* Result orientation
* Team leadership
* Relationship building
* Influencing skills
* Ownership and accountability
* Problem\-solving
* People development
  

  

**Key Success Measures**
------------------------


* Achievement of sales and revenue targets
* Year\-on\-year business growth
* Customer satisfaction score
* Store profitability and ROI
* Stock management and inventory accuracy
* Compliance with company policies
* Team engagement and retention
* Quality of new hires
* Training effectiveness
* Reduction in customer complaints and non\-compliance cases

JOB ID: R\-248038 LOCATION: India \- Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Jun. 19, 2026 CATEGORY: Information Systems
**Role Name: Senior Associate Software Engineer**

**Department Name:** Technology

**ABOUT AMGEN WORLDWIDE**


Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting\-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today.


You’ve earned your degree \& have built up experience. How will you use that achievement to reach your goals? Do more with the knowledge you’ve worked hard to acquire and the passion you already have. At Amgen, our shared mission—to serve patients—drives all that we do. It is key to our becoming one of the world’s leading biotechnology companies, reaching over 10 million patients worldwide. Become the professional you are meant to be in this meaningful role.

**ABOUT AMGEN INDIA**


Amgen India is located in HITEC City, a suburb of Hyderabad, occupying six floors of the RMZ Spire Tower 110\. The city of Hyderabad, located in the state of Telangana, well known for its world\-class talent across medicine, life sciences and data sciences and the rapidly advancing field of artificial intelligence (AI). The site can accommodate up to 3,000 people and is operational since Q4 2024\. Amgen India will initially build and accelerate new technology solutions and digital capabilities at scale that will enhance efficiency across the enterprise The site will offer roles that strengthen key areas of Amgen’s business, including AI, data science, life science and other additional global capabilities over time.

**Role Description:**


The Sr Associate Software Engineer will contribute to the design, development, enhancement, and support of enterprise CRM and commercial technology solutions built on Salesforce and Conga CLM/CPQ platforms. This role is responsible for developing scalable application components, configuring platform capabilities, supporting integrations, and delivering high\-quality solutions aligned with business and technical requirements.


The ideal candidate possesses strong software engineering fundamentals, hands\-on Salesforce platform development experience, and understanding of enterprise business processes related to contract lifecycle management and configure\-price\-quote capabilities. The role requires active participation throughout the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.


This position requires independent execution of medium\-complexity technical workstreams, collaboration across global teams, and contribution to engineering best practices that improve platform scalability, maintainability, and operational efficiency.


You will be part of a team focused on Global CRM capabilities. Amgen leverages fully integrated, best\-in\-class technologies with Salesforce.com serving as the core platform architecture and business capability enablers such as Conga CLM and CPQ.

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, enhance, and support scalable solutions on Salesforce and Conga CLM/CPQ platforms
* Develop custom applications and platform capabilities using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL, Flows, validation rules, and Salesforce automation technologies
* Configure and enhance Conga CLM and CPQ capabilities including templates, workflows, approvals, product configurations, pricing rules, and contract lifecycle processes
* Contribute to technical design decisions and solution implementation approaches aligned with enterprise architecture standards and business requirements
* Collaborate with product managers, architects, business analysts, and cross\-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions
* Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce and enterprise applications using REST APIs, middleware technologies, and integration best practices
* Develop reusable components and optimize application performance, scalability, security, and maintainability
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering standards, development best practices, and continuous improvement initiatives
* Execute and support deployment and release management activities across development, testing, and production environments
* Support CI/CD processes, source control management, environment coordination, and release readiness activities
* Troubleshoot and resolve application defects, integration issues, and production incidents while providing timely root cause analysis and remediation
* Create and maintain technical documentation including solution designs, configuration details, integration specifications, and deployment procedures
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, estimation, retrospectives, and release planning
* Monitor platform health and proactively identify opportunities for automation, optimization, and operational improvements
* Provide technical guidance to junior team members and contribute to knowledge sharing within the engineering organization

 **Basic Qualifications and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree / Master's Degree and 5\-8 years relevant software engineering experience
* 2\+ years of experience in Salesforce development or enterprise application development
* Hands\-on experience with Apex, SOQL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, and Salesforce platform development
* Experience working with CRM and enterprise SaaS platforms such as Salesforce, Veeva, or similar technologies
* Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile methodologies, and …

jobs.title: Product Manager, Advanced Enterprise Data Platform
jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end\-to\-end, 0 to 1, etc).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in a technology or business related field.
* Experience working in data, enterprise, platform or infrastructure.
* Experience working in a geographically distributed team with cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Experience managing complex data platforms, drafting detailed Product Requirements Documents (PRDs), and executing long\-term product roadmaps.
* Deep knowledge of AI/ML foundations, RAG, and semantic modeling.
* Ability to define platform success metrics from user feedback while ensuring strict data privacy and security compliance.

**About the job**
-----------------


At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  

  

In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  

  

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  


As a Product Manager for the Enterprise Data Platform (EDP), you will drive the direction to transform Google’s data landscape into an AI\-ready ecosystem. You will lead the development of advanced semantic and reasoning capabilities, such as hybrid search, enterprise knowledge graphs, and GraphRAG, to unify our currently fragmented data space. By bridging structured and unstructured sources, you will enable autonomous agents to execute high\-stakes business workflows with deterministic accuracy and safety. You will collaborate across cross\-functional domains to drive product\-market fit, ensuring our platform provides the secure, governed, and certified data foundation required to power Google’s next generation of agentic intelligence.


At Corp Eng, we build world\-leading business solutions that scale a more helpful Google for everyone. As Google’s IT organization, we provide end\-to\-end solutions for organizations across Google. We deliver the right tools, platforms, and experiences for all Googlers as they create more helpful products and services for everyone. In the simplest terms, we are Google for Googlers.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Drive the platform's goal by balancing immediate operational needs with a clear roadmap for an AI\-ready, unified enterprise data ecosystem.
* Generate and define detailed product requirements and feature specifications to solve complex data fragmentation and governance challenges.
* Partner with business units to align dependencies and ensure the platform meets wide\-ranging enterprise requirements.
* Engage directly with domain owners to lead platform adoption, optimize common capabilities, and achieve product\-market fit.
* Define satisfaction metrics through user feedback while navigating ambiguity to maintain enterprise standards and high\-impact delivery.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.description:
**Job title** : Software Engineer


* **Location** : Hyderabad

Opella is the self\-care challenger with the purest and **third\-largest portfolio in the Over\-The\-Counter (OTC) \& Vitamins, Minerals \& Supplements (VMS) market globally** .


Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by **making self\-care as simple as it should be** . For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting.


At the core of this mission is our **100 loved brands** , our **11,000\-strong global team, our 13 best\-in\-class manufacturing sites** and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.


**B Corp certified in multiple markets** , we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com .


### ***About the Job:***

We are looking for a **Software Engineer** to support the development, maintenance, and evolution of Opella’s web platform.  



  

The role will focus mainly on **front\-end development, CMS implementation, website support, and platform delivery activities** across our global brand websites. The engineer will work closely with senior engineers, product owners, DevOps, QA, and external partners to deliver reliable, performant, and maintainable web solutions.


This is a hands\-on engineering role suited for someone who can work independently on well\-defined tasks, contribute to implementation quality, and grow into broader platform responsibilities over time.  



**Main Responsibilities:**
--------------------------

### **Front\-end development**

Develop and maintain front\-end components, templates, and website features using modern web technologies.


Support implementation of responsive, accessible, and performant web pages.


Translate business and UX requirements into clean, maintainable front\-end code.


Collaborate with QA and other engineers to troubleshoot defects and improve delivery quality.


Follow established coding standards, component patterns, and platform guidelines.

jobs.title: Leading Associate Vice President - Product Owner (ITSM) [T500-26220]
jobs.description:
**About Deutsche Börse Group:** 




 Headquartered in Frankfurt, Germany, Deutsche Börse Group is a leading international exchange organization and market infrastructure provider. They empower investors, financial institutions, and companies by facilitating access to global capital markets.
 



 Their India centre is located in Hyderabad, serves as a key strategic hub and comprises India’s top\-tier tech talent. They focus on crafting advanced IT solutions that elevate market infrastructure and services. Deutsche Börse Group in India is composed of a team of capital market engineers forming the backbone of financial markets worldwide.
 



  





**Corporate IT – together with the CTO Area \- is driving together the Implementation of ServiceNow for IT Service \& Asset Management. This is a multi\-year program professionalizing and standardizing the handling of CMDB, Asset Management, ITSM and other processes/activities. The IT SAM Program is pursuing a.o. following goals:** 



* Deliver a group wide IT Service \& Asset Management Platform in the cloud in line with the enterprise architecture
* Replace legacy technology (CRM7\) to Cloud native technology track
* Drive cultural change form proprietary DBG specific implementation into a SaaS solution



  





**Your Mission:** 




 We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Product Owner to lead the topic of ITSM (for internal \& external users and customers) in our IT Service \& Asset Management (IT SAM) capabilities. You will be at the heart of our digital transformation, driving the implementation and evolution of our new central platform. This is a key role in shifting our culture from a legacy, process\-heavy environment to a modern, cloud\-native, and service\-oriented model.
 



 If you are a practical leader who thinks in terms of products and services that deliver real value, and you are passionate about building modern IT solutions, this is the role for you. We need a doer, not just a theorist, who can cut through complexity and guide our organization towards a more efficient and user\-centric future.
 



  





**Tasks/Responsibilities:** 



* **Own the Product Vision \& Strategy:** 
 You will define and champion a clear product vision for IT Service and Asset Management. You'll translate the strategic goals of our multi\-year transformation program into a prioritized, value\-driven product backlog. This includes owning, developing, maintaining, prioritizing and securing completeness of the Product Backlog with, on top of business requirements, external and internal audit items, BAU activities and Enablers.
* **Lead with a Practical Mindset:** 
 While familiarity with ITIL is essential, your focus will be on practical application. You will pragmatically balance business needs with governance requirements, ensuring we build effective services, not just "paper tiger" processes.
* **Drive Agile Execution** 
 : As the "Voice of the Customer," you will guide our Agile development team. This includes breaking down features into clear user stories, defining objectives, goals and acceptance criteria, and ensuring the team is always working on what matters most. You will be the final authority on accepting work, using Behavior\-Driven Development (BDD) practices and practices like Definition of Ready (DoR) and the Definition of Done (DoD), ensuring the final product meets our high standards.
* **Champion Service Adoption \& Value:** 
 You will own the strategy for product adoption, ensuring users understand and benefit from the new platform. A key part of your role will be evaluating new features from our SaaS vendor to ensure we are maximizing the value of our investment.
* **Collaborate and Communicate:** 
 You will be the central point of contact between senior stakeholders, business users, and the development team. Your ability to communicate clearly and manage relationships at all levels will be critical to aligning everyone on the product roadmap and ensuring smooth execution.
* **Manage the Basics:** 
 This includes managing JIRA / Confluence / SharePoint together with the Product Team. Organizing, preparing and following up different types of program meetings. Contributing to program communication content and channels (mail, newsletter, intranet)



  





**Qualifications/required skills:** 



* **Proven Product Ownership Experience:** 
 5\+ years of experience as a Product Owner (or similar role) in a large\-scale, enterprise Agile environment.
* **Deep Domain Expertise:** 
 Strong, hands\-on experience with IT Service Management (ITSM) processes and a deep understanding of the underlying data (CMDB).
* **Practical SaaS Implementation Skills:** 
 Demonstrated experience in implementing and managing enterprise SaaS solutions (ServiceNow experience is a significant advantage). You understand how to leverage out\-of\-the\-box capabilities over excessive customization.
* **A Product \& Service Mentality:** 
 You are a strategic thinker who focuses on customer needs and delivering tangible business value. You have a track record of simplifying complex problems and communicating effectively with both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* **Leadership \& Influence:** 
 Excellent communication, negotiation, and decision\-making skills. You are confident engaging with stakeholders at all levels and can operate effectively in a multi\-national environment.
* **Industry Context:** 
 Experience working in the financial services industry or another highly regulated environment is highly desirable.
* **Language:** 
 Excellent proficiency in written and spoken English is required. Basic German is a plus.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
The Product Owner (PO) within Kroll’s Chief Data Office (CDO) is accountable for the end‑to‑end ownership, delivery, and adoption of enterprise data products. This role serves as the single point of accountability for product vision, stakeholder alignment, roadmap execution, and experience quality across assigned data domains.
   

  

 The Product Owner partners closely with
 **Business stakeholders, Data Engineering, BI/Reporting, Data Science, Governance, and Platform teams** 
 to ensure data products are reliable, intuitive, scalable, and aligned with Kroll’s strategic priorities. The role emphasizes
 **clarity of ownership, predictable delivery, and measurable business impact** 
 in a complex, enterprise data environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Ownership \& Accountability**
* Define and own the product vision, roadmap, and backlog for enterprise data, analytics, or AI product areas.
* Serve as the single point of accountability for product outcomes, delivery health, and user experience.
* Define and communicate product goals, success metrics, and value drivers to stakeholders and delivery teams.
* Ensure products operate with clear ownership, release discipline, and lifecycle management, behaving like true products—not one‑off projects.


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Business Alignment**
* Act as the primary interface between the CDO and business, finance, and functional leaders for assigned domains.
* Partner with stakeholders to prioritize demand, manage tradeoffs, and align delivery to business timelines.
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements without compromising data integrity or architectural standards.
* Establish and maintain trusted relationships that enable fast decision‑making and alignment.


**Backlog, Roadmap \& Delivery Management**
* Own and maintain a prioritized, well‑defined backlog with clear acceptance criteria and readiness standards.
* Work with Program Managers, Scrum Masters, and delivery teams to plan releases and manage dependencies.
* Balance short‑term delivery needs with long‑term product health, scalability, and maintainability.
* Surface risks, constraints, or scope trade‑offs early to enable leadership decisions.


**Governance, Quality \& Standards**
* Partner with Data Governance, Data Stewards, and Platform Owners to ensure:
+ Consistent KPI definitions and metric logic
+ Data quality, lineage, and trust standards
+ Alignment with enterprise data architecture and security policies

* Ensure products meet operational readiness standards prior to release and are supported post‑launch.


**Adoption, Value \& Continuous Improvement**
* Drive product adoption by ensuring solutions is intuitive, reliable, and aligned to real user workflows.
* Define and track usage, adoption, and value realization metrics.
* Collect feedback and iterate to continuously improve product experience and impact.
* Support leadership by providing a clear narrative on what is delivered, what value it creates, and what comes next.


**Required**
**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 5\+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Business Analysis, Analytics, or Data‑centric roles.
* Proven ability to own roadmaps, backlogs, and stakeholder relationships in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of data, reporting, analytics, or BI platforms (e.g., Power BI, Databricks, data warehouses).
* Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery models with engineering and analytics teams.
* Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to translate between business objectives and technical execution.


**Preferred**
* Experience in a Chief Data Office, Analytics, or Enterprise Reporting organization.
* Familiarity with data governance, semantic models, KPI standardization, and self‑service analytics.
* Experience supporting finance, operations, or enterprise‑wide reporting domains.
* Prior experience working in a vendor‑heavy environment and helping transition to more internal ownership.


**Leadership Behaviors \& Expectations**
* Operates with clear ownership and accountability.
* Brings structure, clarity, and discipline to ambiguous problem spaces.
* Makes trade‑offs explicitly and escalates decisions appropriately.
* Focuses on outcomes and value, not just delivery.
* Trusted partner to both business leaders and technical teams.


**Why This Role Matters**
 The Product Owner is a
 **critical enabler of CDO’s product‑led operating model** 
 , ensuring that data and analytics investments deliver consistent, trusted, and measurable value to the firm—while reducing dependency on informal workarounds, fragmented ownership, and vendor‑driven execution.

jobs.title: Lead Product Owner

jobs.title: Technical product owner
jobs.description:
Job Description: Technical Product Owner
 



  





 The Technical Product Owner is responsible for translating business goals into clear, actionable technical requirements and ensuring delivery teams build solutions that maximize customer and business value. This role bridges product strategy, architecture, engineering, and operations by managing the product backlog, defining user stories and acceptance criteria, prioritizing technical and functional work, and driving execution across agile teams. Successful Technical Product Owners combine strong product judgment, technical fluency, stakeholder management, and data\-driven decision\-making.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Own and maintain the product backlog for technical and functional features, enablers, integrations, and technical debt.
* Partner with business stakeholders, architects, engineers, and designers to define product vision, roadmap, and release priorities.
* Translate business needs into epics, features, and user stories with clear acceptance criteria and technical context.
* Prioritize backlog items based on business value, customer impact, risk, dependencies, and implementation complexity.
* Work closely with engineering teams during sprint planning, refinement, demos, and retrospectives to ensure alignment and delivery readiness.
* Clarify requirements, answer team questions, and make timely tradeoff decisions to keep delivery moving.
* Align product decisions with enterprise architecture, security, compliance, reliability, and scalability requirements.
* Coordinate across teams to manage dependencies, integrations, and release readiness.
* Use customer feedback, analytics, operational metrics, and testing results to refine priorities and improve outcomes.
* Communicate progress, risks, decisions, and roadmap changes to stakeholders and leadership.
* Apply specification\-driven development (SDD) practices and AI\-assisted tools to generate specifications and develop prototypes that validate business asks and expected business value.



 Required Qualifications
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5\+ years of experience in Product Owner, Product Manager, Business Analyst, or related delivery roles in software or digital product environments.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum or SAFe environments with cross\-functional delivery teams.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle, APIs, integrations, cloud platforms, data flows, and system dependencies.
* Proven ability to write user stories, define acceptance criteria, and manage/prioritize a product backlog.
* Experience collaborating with engineering, architecture, QA, UX, and business stakeholders.
* Strong conceptual, analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and facilitation skills, including whiteboarding, written documentation, and executive\-level presentations.
* Experience with delivery and product management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with specification\-driven development (SDD) and experience using AI\-assisted tools such as OpenSpec, Spec\-Kit, Superpowers, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent platforms to generate specifications and develop prototypes that validate business asks and expected business value.



 Preferred Qualifications
 


* Certification such as CSPO, SAFe POPM, CSM, or equivalent agile/product credential.
* Experience in regulated enterprise environments such as healthcare, financial services, insurance, or other compliance\-driven industries.
* Working knowledge of cloud services, platform architecture, data governance, DevSecOps, and observability practices.
* Experience supporting modernization initiatives, platform migrations, or digital transformation programs.
* Prior technical background in software engineering, systems analysis, solution architecture, or technical business analysis.



 Core Skills
 


* Backlog management and prioritization
* User story development and acceptance criteria definition
* Executive communication, whiteboarding, and written documentation
* Technical requirement analysis
* Agile planning and release management
* Dependency management and risk mitigation
* Data\-informed decision\-making
* Customer\-centric thinking
* Cross\-functional leadership without direct authority
* Experience with SDD and AI\-assisted spec/prototype generation tools to accelerate requirements definition and business\-value validation



 Success Measures
 


* Clear, prioritized, and delivery\-ready backlog aligned to roadmap objectives
* Improved sprint predictability and release quality
* Reduced ambiguity in requirements and fewer delivery blockers
* Strong alignment between business needs and technical implementation
* Positive stakeholder and team feedback on collaboration and clarity
* Measurable business and customer outcomes from shipped features

jobs.description:
**About Deutsche Börse Group:** 




 Headquartered in Frankfurt, Germany, Deutsche Börse Group is a leading international exchange organization and market infrastructure provider. They empower investors, financial institutions, and companies by facilitating access to global capital markets.
 



 Their India center is located in Hyderabad, serves as a key strategic hub and comprises India’s top\-tier tech talent. They focus on crafting advanced IT solutions that elevate market infrastructure and services. Deutsche Börse Group in India is composed of a team of capital market engineers forming the backbone of financial markets worldwide.
 



  





**Field of activity:** 




 Corporate IT – together with the CTO Area \- is driving together the Implementation of ServiceNow for IT Service \& Asset Management. This is a multi\-year program professionalizing and standardizing the handling of CMDB, Asset Management, ITSM and other processes/activities. The IT SAM Program is pursuing a.o. following goals:
 


* Deliver a group wide IT Service \& Asset Management Platform in the cloud in line with the enterprise architecture
* Replace legacy technology (CRM7\) to Cloud native technology track
* Drive cultural change form proprietary DBG specific implementation into a SaaS solution



  





**Your Mission:** 




 We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Product Owner to lead the topic of CMDB, Configuration and Asset Management in our IT Service \& Asset Management (IT SAM) capabilities. You will be at the heart of our digital transformation, driving the implementation and evolution of our new central platform. This is a key role in shifting our culture from a legacy, process\-heavy environment to a modern, cloud\-native, and service\-oriented model.
 



 If you are a practical leader who thinks in terms of products and services that deliver real value, and you are passionate about building modern IT solutions, this is the role for you. We need a doer, not just a theorist, who can cut through complexity and guide our organization towards a more efficient and user\-centric future.
 



  





**Tasks / Responsibilities:** 



* **Own the Product Vision \& Strategy:** 
 You will define and champion a clear product vision for IT Service and Asset Management. You'll translate the strategic goals of our multi\-year transformation program into a prioritized, value\-driven product backlog. This includes owning, developing, maintaining, prioritizing and securing completeness of the Product Backlog with, on top of business requirements, external and internal audit items, BAU activities and Enablers.
* **Lead with a Practical Mindset:** 
 While familiarity with ITIL is essential, your focus will be on practical application. You will pragmatically balance business needs with governance requirements, ensuring we build effective services, not just "paper tiger" processes.
* **Drive Agile Execution** 
 : As the "Voice of the Customer," you will guide our Agile development team. This includes breaking down features into clear user stories, defining objectives, goals and acceptance criteria, and ensuring the team is always working on what matters most. You will be the final authority on accepting work, using Behaviour\-Driven Development (BDD) practices and practices like Definition of Ready (DoR) and the Definition of Done (DoD), ensuring the final product meets our high standards.
* **Champion Service Adoption \& Value:** 
 You will own the strategy for product adoption, ensuring users understand and benefit from the new platform. A key part of your role will be evaluating new features from our SaaS vendor to ensure we are maximizing the value of our investment.
* **Collaborate and Communicate:** 
 You will be the central point of contact between senior stakeholders, business users, and the development team. Your ability to communicate clearly and manage relationships at all levels will be critical to aligning everyone on the product roadmap and ensuring smooth execution.
* **Manage the Basics:** 
 This includes managing JIRA / Confluence / SharePoint together with the Product Team. Organizing, preparing and following up different types of program meetings. Contributing to program communication content and channels (mail, newsletter, intranet)



  





**Qualifications / Required skills:** 



* **Proven Product Ownership Experience:** 
 5\+ years of experience as a Product Owner (or similar role) in a large\-scale, enterprise Agile environment.
* **Deep Domain Expertise:** 
 Strong, hands\-on experience with IT Configuration, IT Asset Management (ITAM) and IT Service Management (ITSM) processes and a deep understanding of the underlying data (CMDB).
* **Practical SaaS Implementation Skills:** 
 Demonstrated experience in implementing and managing enterprise SaaS solutions (ServiceNow experience is a significant advantage). You understand how to leverage out\-of\-the\-box capabilities over excessive customization.
* **A Product \& Service Mentality:** 
 You are a strategic thinker who focuses on customer needs and delivering tangible business value. You have a track record of simplifying complex problems and communicating effectively with both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* **Leadership \& Influence:** 
 Excellent communication, negotiation, and decision\-making skills. You are confident engaging with stakeholders at all levels and can operate effectively in a multi\-national environment.
* **Industry Context:** 
 Experience working in the financial services industry or another highly regulated environment is highly desirable.
* **Language:** 
 Excellent proficiency in written and spoken English is required. Basic German is a plus.

jobs.description:
Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.
  
  

Die Position
  
  

Lead/ Senior Analyst – Business Research/ Market Intelligence
  
Roche India – Roche Services\& Solutions
  
Hyderabad/ Chennai
  
  

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
  
  

That’s what makes us Roche.
  
  

Roche has established Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) at Chennai/ Hyderabad to drive analytics\& technology driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.
  
  

As aLead/ Senior Analyst, you will act as a dedicated SME to Roche’s global business partners. You will transcend traditional data collection by integrating Clinical and Commercial Competitive Intelligence (CI), Market intelligence with advanced GenAI\-driven analytics. Your goal is to provide high\-level strategic foresight using established business frameworks to influence Roche’s global product pipeline and commercial launch strategies.
  
  

Your Opportunity
  
  

* Integrated Strategic Competitive/ Market Intelligence: Lead the end\-to\-end monitoring of the competitive landscape, bifurcating insights into Clinical CI (R pipeline, trial design shifts, MoA breakthroughs) and Commercial CI (pricing, market access, field force shifts, and launch trajectories)
* Strategic Framework Application: Synthesize complex market signals into actionable strategies using structured frameworks such as SWOT, PESTLE, Porter’s Five Forces, and Patient Journey Mapping to identify unmet needs and white\-space opportunities
* GenAI\& Innovation: Architect and implement GenAI\-powered workflows (e.g., LLMs for rapid secondary research synthesis, automated earnings call sentiment analysis, or GPT\-based clinical trial summarization) to increase the velocity and depth of strategic recommendations
* High\-Stakes Conference Coverage (ASCO, ESMO, AACR, JP Morgan, Jefferies, etc.): Provide pre\-conference/ post\-conference impact assessment analysis of competitor data readouts on Roche’s portfolio
* Strategic Advisory: Transform market insights from public\& proprietary data sources (e.g. CT.gov, Clarivate, AlphaSense, EvaluatePharma) into "Executive Stories" that provide clear "So What?" and "Now What?" recommendations to partners\& senior leadership
* Predictive Intelligence: Flag "Trigger Events" (e.g., Breakthrough Designations, FDA/ regulatory signals, M activity) and perform Scenario Planning to assess potential implications for Roche brands


Who you are
  
  

* You hold a bachelor's degree in B. Tech/B.E./B. Pharm and 5 to 8 years of experience inStrategic Business Research/ Market Research/ CI within Pharma/Life Sciences.Preferably, you have a Master's degree in Life Sciences/Biotechnology
* Methodology: Expert\-level proficiency in applying Business Research Frameworks (SWOT, PESTLE) to the pharmaceutical lifecycle—from Phase I to Loss of Exclusivity (LoE).
* Tech\-Savviness: Proven experience or a strong vision for using GenAI tools to automate data extraction and enhance strategic consulting.
* Commercial Acumen: Deep understanding of the Drug Development Process, including clinical trial endpoints, regulatory pathways (FDA/EMA), and commercial launch excellence.
* Communication: Ability to influence global stakeholders through structured communication and data visualization.
* Self\-Driven Ownership: A proactive "self\-starter" who manages complex projects with minimal guidance in a fast\-paced global environment.
* Innovative Problem\-Solver: Possesses an agile, GenAI\-forward mindset to reinvent research workflows and tackle intricate life science challenges.
* Strategic Influencer: Passionate about the "why" behind the data, using structured narratives to move stakeholders from insights to action.


Wer wir sind
  
  

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation an. Mehr als 100\.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, wissenschaftliche Fortschritte zu erzielen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und für zukünftige Generationen. Durch unser Engagement werden über 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostik\-Produkten durchgeführt. Wir ermutigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und hohe Ziele zu setzen, um lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern.
  
  

Gemeinsam können wir eine gesündere Zukunft gestalten.
  
  

Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber, der die Chancengleichheit fördert.

Through our P\-S\-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well\-being, and value their contributions to the company.
   

  

 Our Culture
   

  

 Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
As the recognized global standard for project\-based businesses, Deltek delivers software and information solutions to help organizations achieve their purpose. Our market leadership stems from the work of our diverse employees who are united by a passion for learning, growing and making a difference. At Deltek, we take immense pride in creating a balanced, values\-driven environment, where every employee feels included and empowered to do their best work. Our employees put our core values into action daily, creating a one\-of\-a\-kind culture that has been recognized globally. Thanks to our incredible team, Deltek has been named one of America's Best Midsize Employers by Forbes, a Best Place to Work by Glassdoor, a Top Workplace by The Washington Post and a Best Place to Work in Asia by World HRD Congress. www.deltek.com
**Business Summary**


Deltek Product Strategy is a team with a passion for delivering solutions to power success for project\-based businesses. We use research and innovation to build products and experiences that connect processes across the entire project lifecycle. We are thought leaders who have a deep understanding of our customers, their industries and the challenges they face. Join us as we bring Deltek solutions to the market to help our customers achieve operational excellence.
**Position Responsibilities**


**About the Role**  

Deltek is seeking a visionary and highly tactical **Product Manager for Shared Services**. In this role, you will not build for a single end\-user; instead, you will build the foundational "building blocks"—services, capabilities, APIs, and common components—that power Deltek’s entire ecosystem of products.  

  

You will lead the shift from siloed feature development to a unified service architecture. This requires a unique blend of strategic foresight to see commonalities across diverse products and the tactical grit to execute in an environment where requirements are often ambiguous and unrefined.
  

  

In this role, as a Technical product manager, you will own the technical definition, coherence, and delivery readiness of major product capabilities. You will operate at the intersection of Product Management, UX, Engineering, and Shared Services, ensuring that product intent becomes scalable, high\-quality, technically sound software. This is a role for someone who loves diving into data models, integration patterns, architectural trade\-offs, and system behaviour working together with engineering teams to drive momentum.  

Ideal candidates
  

  

We are looking for someone ready to evolve their career. This role is a departure from traditional PM work:* **From Specific to General:** You don't just solve a problem for one persona; you build a solution that solves it for *every* persona across the company.
* **From Roadmap to Ecosystem:** You aren't just managing a backlog; you are managing a platform ecosystem where your success is measured by the speed and ease with which *other* teams can build on your work.
* **From Certainty to Discovery:** You thrive when the path isn't clear. You enjoy the "science" of product management—forming a thesis, building an MVP, and iterating based on internal feedback.

### **Why This Role Matters**


At Deltek, we believe in "Powering Project Success." By building shared services, you are the force multiplier for our entire product organization. You are the reason we can ship faster, maintain higher quality, and provide a seamless, unified experience for our customers across every product we sell.  

  

**Key Responsibilities*** **Platform Evangelism:** Act as the bridge between multiple product lines, identifying overlapping needs and distilling them into a single, high\-leverage shared service strategy.
* **Hypothesis\-Driven Development:** Navigate "the grey." You will start with unclear requirements and use rapid discovery, prototyping, and hypothesis testing to validate what "generally useful" looks like for Deltek.
* **Strategic Abstraction:** Design services (e.g., identity, billing, reporting, or workflow engines) that are robust enough for complex enterprise needs but flexible enough to be adopted by various product teams.
* **Internal Stakeholder Management:** Treat internal product teams as your "customers." You must balance their competing roadmaps and timelines to ensure adoption of shared services.
* **Lifecycle Ownership:** Define the roadmap, SLOs (Service Level Objectives), and documentation for shared components to ensure they are "developer\-ready" and scalable.
* **Architectural Strategy:** Translate high\-level business capabilities into technical blueprints, owning the strategy for data models, integration patterns, and third\-party service alignment.
* **System Coherence:** Ensure technical consistency across workflows and shared services, partnering with Engineering and QE to define system behaviour, telemetry, and observability standards.
* **Dependency Orchestration:** Proactively identify and resolve technical blockers across product pods to ensure shared\-service delivery never slows down the broader organization.
* **Platform Innovation:** Drive the adoption of AI\-enabled workflows and automation tools to accelerate documentation, system modelling, and overall delivery velocity.

**Qualifications**


* **Experience:** 5\+ years in Product Management, preferably within SaaS, ERP, or Project\-Based industries.
* **Platform Thinking:** Proven ability to think in terms of APIs, microservices, and "horizontal" capabilities rather than just "vertical" UI features.
* **Ambiguity Tolerance:** A track record of taking a vague concept and turning it into a functional, adopted service.
* **Project\-Based Expertise:** Familiarity with the complexities of project\-based businesses (e.g., time tracking, resource management, project accounting) is a massive plus.
* **Communication:** Exceptional ability to negotiate and influence technical architects and other Product Leaders…

**Description**
 Opportunity: The IN B2B market is made of 63 MM Micro \& Small Customers and 0\.5MM Medium \& Large customers together spending $400B annually. That is the market segment that the Amazon Business team is creating solutions for.
   

  

 Problem: Over the past many years, individual shoppers in India have come to appreciate the convenience, infinite selection and competitive pricing that Amazon offers.
   

  

 While Indian businesses want many of the same benefits listed above, e\-commerce is still not a preferred/ reliable purchase option for them. That is because the needs of the Indian businesses are different from that of individual shoppers and the current state of consumer\-oriented B2C platforms does not fully address the requirements of a business purchase. That is the problem that the PM team at Amazon Business intends to solve. We intend to make buying online as simple, reliable and cost\-effective for businesses as it is for individuals.
   

  

 This means that the PMs in Amazon Business India have to re\-look at every aspect of the customer's journey \- browsing, selection, price display, checkout, payment, delivery and returns experience and enhance them to fir the needs of the business customer. In addition, the team has to build new products \- approval workflows, GST compliance, multi\-user accounts, spend analytics reports etc. to address unique requirements of Indian business customers. We have the same complex problems, ambiguity, fast pace you see in a startup \- but contained within the larger Amazon organization.
   

  

 The Role: This role will own the charter to significantly improve Enterprise procurement experience by partnering with tech teams, global/IN product development teams, marketing, operations, legal, accounting, tax, and finance teams. The roadmap will be a mix of IN first innovations and of IN adaptations of global product features.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is someone who is enthusiastic about managing challenging, ambiguous projects across multiple teams and locations. He or she is comfortable marshaling large amounts of data to make decisions and build business cases.
   

  

 The right candidate will share Amazon's passion for the customer—someone who understands the importance of compelling features and functionalities in driving great customer and seller experience.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of product management experience
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in product, program, or project management in leading cross\-functional teams in delivery of major new products or services


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of SQL and VBA at an advanced level
* Experience building and analyzing cost/benefit scenarios and business cases and communicating results throughout the organization

**Job Title \- Senior Product Manager** 




**Location: Bengaluru, Seshadripuram** 




  





  





**ABOUT WISEMONK:** 




 Wisemonk helps global companies hire, pay, and manage talent in India. We started in 2020 with a simple frustration: hiring great engineers in India shouldn't feel like a moon landing. Today we're an Employer of Record platform trusted by 300\+ international companies, managing thousands of employees with a 4\.8 G2 rating, built on doing the hard operational work well: compliant hiring, payroll at scale, and a recruitment engine that actually finds people.
 



  





 That's the foundation. What we're building next is much bigger.
 



  





**THE ROLE:** 




 We're looking for a senior product leader to own product end to end, work directly with the Founder, lead a small design team, and grow into something far larger as the company does.
 



  





 Here's the ambition you'd be signing up for.
 



 Wisemonk is becoming a trust platform: the layer global companies rely on to move hundreds of millions of dollars in payments into India and route them safely across every kind of arrangement, whether that's EOR, contractor\-of\-record, or independent freelancers. In doing that, we're reshaping how the world taps Indian talent, moving past the old IT\-services model toward deep, high\-quality, core\-capability roles, and channeling real dollar inflows and real jobs into the country.
 



  





 The product that makes this work has to be genuinely ambitious. You'd be shaping:
 



 \- Systems that handle large volumes of data and turn it into something useful
 



 \- Intelligent matching that connects the right talent to the right work
 



 \- AI agents built and sold as products in their own right
 



 \- AI embedded natively inside the products people use every day
 



 \- Payments infrastructure carrying hundreds of millions of dollars
 



 \- Deep compliance layers that hold up across many regulatory bodies
 



  





 We think these are some of the most ambitious AI\-native products anyone is building, aimed squarely at industries that haven't meaningfully changed in decades. A lot of it is still unwritten, and you'd help write it.
 



  





**WHAT YOU WILL DO:** 




 \-Own product end to end, from problem discovery and prioritization through shipping and iteration
 



 \- Lead and grow a small design team, and partner closely with engineering on execution
 



 \- Turn a broad, ambitious vision into a concrete, sequenced roadmap, and make the hard calls on what comes first
 



 \- Talk to customers (HR leaders, finance teams, founders hiring internationally across the US, Europe, SEA, and beyond) and turn what you learn into product decisions
 



 \- Build the foundations of how product is run here as the team scales around you.
 



  





**WHAT WE'RE LOOK :\-** 




 \-6\+ years in product, including at least 3 years building an HR/people product sold to global companies
 



 \- Experience owning product end to end at an early\-stage company (Series A or similar), with a track record of helping it grow
 



 \- Comfort operating with ambiguity and limited process; you're as happy defining the problem as solving it
 



 \- Strong instincts for what makes B2B SaaS products genuinely useful, not just feature\-complete
 



 \- Someone who wants their scope to grow with the company
 



  





**Nice to have: prior founder or early\-team experience in B2B SaaS.** 




  





**HOW WE WORK:** 




 We're customer\-obsessed, we cut red tape, and we own outcomes end to end. If that sounds like how you operate, you'll fit right in.

The Software Engineer for AI/ML is a junior to mid\-level engineering role within the Developer Experience Program (EDP), focused on building and integrating AI and machine learning capabilities that directly improve how developers work at Equinix. You will work closely with the EDP engineering lead, product owner, and the broader platform engineering team.

* Assist in the development of agent components within the Agentic Execution Framework — building discrete agent steps, tool integrations, and output parsers that plug into the broader orchestration layer

* Familiarity with prompt engineering fundamentals: few\-shot prompting, chain\-of\-thought, structured output prompting, and basic evaluation techniques

* Familiarity with Git and GitHub workflows; comfort working in a collaborative engineering environment with code reviews and version control
* Basic understanding of software engineering fundamentals: writing testable code, handling errors gracefully, and thinking about production reliability even for AI components


**Qualifications**


* 5\+ years of software engineering experience with meaningful exposure to AI/ML systems, LLM integrations, or data science in a production or near\-production setting — internship or project experience considered
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience with LLM APIs or agentic frameworks through projects, coursework, open source contributions, or professional work — able to show examples of what you have built

* Design, develop, and execute automated test scripts using Salesforce testing tools such as Selenium, Worksoft, BrowserStack, LambdaTest.
* Perform integration testing to ensure smooth communication between Salesforce and third\-party systems (e.g., ERP, payment gateways).

* Re\-test fixed defects and verify that solutions meet acceptance criteria.
* Conduct performance testing to validate the scalability of Salesforce applications using tools like JMeter or LoadRunner.
* Perform API testing to verify integrations with external systems using tools like Postman or SoapUI.
* Participate in Agile sprint cycles to ensure timely delivery of high\-quality Salesforce solutions.
* Contribute to the improvement of testing processes and best practices within the team.
* Provide regular test status reports and defect metrics to management.

jobs.description:
**Work Schedule**


Standard Office Hours (40/wk)**Environmental Conditions**


Office**Job Description**


As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

**Role Summary**

* We are seeking a highly analytical Supply Chain Analyst (Band 7\) to support end\-to\-end supply chain analytics across the CMD LSMS/AAT (Big box instrument) portfolio. This role will enable data\-driven decision\-making through advanced analytics, reporting, and cross\-functional collaboration, cutting across supply planning, managing material issues / shortages, driving inventory and distribution analytics.
**How will you make an impact?**

* On the Chromatography and Mass Spectrometry team, you will aid our supply chain to manufacture innovative instruments, consumables, and software solutions for customers working in the analytical sciences (routine testing markets) and scientific research. Our complete workflow solutions enable productivity and efficiency for customers performing food and beverage testing and manufacturing, environmental and industrial testing, biopharma QA/QC, toxicology, and anti\-doping.
**What will you do?**

* Support SIOP/S\&OE execution through robust analytics, actionable insights, and standardized KPI/performance reporting
* Analyze material shortages to identify root causes and drive mitigation strategies; partner with suppliers to improve forecast alignment and enhance supply risk visibility
* Deliver E\&O inventory analytics and reporting to support business unit inventory optimization and working capital goals
* Extract, interpret, and analyze SAP data using key T\-codes (e.g., MD04, MD07, MB52, VA05, COOIS) to support operational and strategic decision\-making
* Conduct network and distribution analytics focused on service levels, transportation cost, lead times, and inventory positioning to support stocking strategy decisions across the business unit
* Support supply chain transformation initiatives, including footprint optimization, BOM analytics, SKU rationalization, and operational efficiency programs
* Partner with the master data team to identify data integrity issues, recommend corrective actions, and improve overall data accuracy and governance across supply chain systems
 **How will you get here?**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Operations, or related field
**Experience**

* 5–8 years of relevant supply chain analytics / planning experience
* Strong expertise across 2\+ areas: demand, supply, production, inventory, or distribution
* Expertise in SAP ERP system, advanced Excel, SQL, and data visualization tools (Power BI/Tableau) to develop dashboards, KPIs, and executive\-level reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to synthesize large, complex datasets into actionable business insights and present recommendations to operations and senior leadership teams.
**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities**

* Analytical and statistical skills including the ability to develop and report metrics, develop predictive models and prescriptive analytics.
* Experience with advanced planning systems (a plus)
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English – shown through both written and spoken communication.
* Strong analytical and stakeholder management skills

You’ll be part of a fast\-moving, high\-impact environment focused on leveraging business intelligence and advanced analytics to solve real\-world problems.  

This role combines technical expertise with business understanding to uncover and communicate actionable insights using cutting\-edge statistical and analytical techniques.  

  

Behind one of the world’s best loved brands is a uniquely capable and brilliant team of data scientists, engineers and analysts. The Target Data \& Analytics team creates the tools and data products to sustainably educate and enable our business partners to make great data\-based decisions at Target. We help develop the technology that personalizes the guest experience, from product recommendations to relevant ad content. We’re also the source of the data and analytics behind Target’s Internet of Things (iOT) applications, fraud detection, Supply Chain optimization and demand forecasting. We play a key role in identifying the test\-and\-measure or A/B test opportunities that continuously help Target improve the guest experience, whether they love to shop in stores or at Target.com.


Key Responsibilities:  

 Translate business problems into well\-defined analytical questions and structured  

approaches  

 Support scenario, decision, and action modelling to evaluate business trade\-offs and  

inform recommended actions  

 Partner with Target business stakeholders to understand priorities and roadmaps,

**Business Systems Analyst, GTM Systems** 




 Business Technology \| HealthEdge
 



 HealthEdge is in a period of rapid growth and consolidation following recent mergers. The Business Technology team exists to make sure the systems that power our business keep up – not just running, but evolving alongside the teams that depend on them. We’re hiring a Business Systems Analyst to join our GTM Systems team and help us do exactly that.
 



  





 The GTM Systems team owns Salesforce and the broader GTM tech stack that powers how our Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Professional Services and Support organizations operate. As a BSA, you’ll be a core contributor on that team – building and maintaining solutions, partnering with GTM stakeholders to translate business needs into system changes, and helping the team run well day to day.
 



  





 If you love turning business problems into clean system solutions, are genuinely curious about how AI tools can change the way work gets done, and thrive when you’re learning something new every week – this role is for you.
 



**In This Role, You’ll Get To** 



* Build and ship.
* **Build and ship.** 
 Contribute to Salesforce platform work across your GTM domain – configuration, flows, objects and data – from requirements through deployment and ongoing support.
* **Support AI enablement.** 
 Participate in AI strategy work alongside senior teammates – learning how AI tools like Claude and Salesforce Einstein are applied to GTM workflows and contributing to implementation.
* **Be a reliable partner.** 
 Build working relationships with GTM stakeholders – gathering requirements clearly, communicating progress honestly, and following through on what you commit to.
* **Think before you build.** 
 Develop the habit of thinking upstream and downstream before making changes – understanding what else a solution might touch and flagging risks before they become problems.
* **Connect your work to outcomes.** 
 Start building the habit of understanding why you’re building something, not just what – connecting system changes to the business problems they’re solving.
* **Use AI in your work.** 
 Actively use AI tools in your daily workflow – for documentation, analysis, testing and solution design – and help build a team culture where AI\-first is the default.
* **Keep the lights on.** 
 Support platform health: data integrity, security, integrations and the day\-to\-day responsiveness that keeps end users moving.



**What We’re Looking For** 



* 5\+ years in business systems, sales/revenue operations, or GTM technology roles
* **Salesforce experience with a builder’s mindset –** 
 you’re most comfortable when you’re in the system doing the work, not just reading about it; Salesforce Admin certification is a plus but not required if you have hands\-on experience
* **Solid grounding in Salesforce fundamentals –** 
 objects, fields, flows, validation rules, reports and dashboards; you may not have seen every scenario yet but you learn fast and know how to find answers
* **Curiosity about AI tools –** 
 you already reach for AI in your work (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot or others), experiment on your own, and are genuinely interested in how AI can change how GTM teams operate; not just willing to use AI when asked, but actively curious
* **Clear communication –** 
 you can translate what stakeholders are asking for into what actually needs to be built, and you know when to ask a clarifying question versus when to move
* **Basic data fluency –** 
 you can work with data in Salesforce to validate what you’ve built and identify when something looks wrong
* **Comfort with ambiguity –** 
 this team is building its own playbook and you’ll help write it; you don’t need perfect specs to get started, you just need enough to ask the right questions
* **Familiarity with the GTM ecosystem –** 
 some exposure to how marketing automation, CS platforms or support tooling connect to Salesforce is a plus, but not required



  





 HealthEdge is an equal opportunity employer. We’re building a team that reflects the diversity of the people we serve.

jobs.description:
**Senior Business Analyst — Reservation Systems**
 Travelopia is a leading conglomerate in the specialist Travel industry, consisting of outstanding experiential travel brands. Our goal is to build captivating and outstanding customer travel experiences, fulfilling their expectations. We strive to become the world's leading travel portal by providing measurable value across our entire brand portfolio worldwide. We use innovative software and technologies to optimise the digital customer journey and build customised software products that improve our outstanding customer experiences.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on Senior Business Analyst role for someone who is technically curious, AI\-savvy, and eager to gain deep expertise in a mission\-critical reservation platform. Beyond gathering requirements, you will analyse data, understand system behaviour, challenge assumptions with evidence, and leverage AI tools to drive faster, smarter problem\-solving.
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Competitive salary, Bonus scheme and Employee benefits
* Collaborative and dynamic work environment
* Flexible working hours and a hybrid working model
* Excellent opportunities for learning, working with global teams
* Opportunity to work on impactful projects that influence the company's growth


**What You'll Do**
* Reservation System Expertise: Develop strong functional expertise in a multi\-brand reservation platform, including legacy and modern modules
* Requirements Gathering \& Analysis: Gather, analyse, and document business requirements and reservation workflows from stakeholders.
* Data \& Database Analysis: Perform SQL\-based data analysis, troubleshoot issues, and validate business logic using database objects.
* Integration \& API Understanding: Understand and document platform integrations, APIs, and data flows across internal and third\-party systems.
* Business–Engineering Bridge: Translate business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical specifications for engineering teams.
* AI Augmentation: Leverage AI tools, including LLMs and automation frameworks, to enhance business analysis, accelerate documentation, uncover data insights, and improve efficiency. Identify and implement AI\-driven opportunities to optimize reservation workflows and operational processes.
* Agile Practices, Support \& Release Management: Lead Agile ceremonies, support UAT, coordinate releases, and manage platform configuration across brands.


**What You'll Bring**
* Professional Level: Senior Business Analyst with rich experience in travel, hospitality, or reservation/booking domains.
* Technical \& Data Skills(Must\-Have): Strong knowledge of relational databases, SQL queries, data structures, triggers, and data flow analysis.
* Integration Literacy (Must\-Have): Practical understanding of APIs, REST services, system integrations, middleware, and data contracts.
* AI Fluency(Must\-Have): Demonstrated habit of using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, or similar)in your daily work for drafting specs, analysing data, generating test scenarios, or automating routine tasks. We are not looking for AI expertise, but for someone who has made AI part of how they work.
* Reservation / Booking Domain Knowledge: Experience with complex booking or reservation platforms supporting multiple brands or business units.
* Multi\-Functional Collaboration \& Agile Expertise: Ability to work across business, technology, and operations teams with hands\-on Agile and SDLC experience.
* Tool Proficiency \& Analytical Mindset: Skilled in JIRA, Confluence, Miro, data\-driven problem solving, and exposure to AI\-focused initiatives is an advantage.


 We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where individuals can be their authentic selves and contribute to meaningful outcomes. Travelopia ensures an inclusive workplace for all. If you need accommodations during the recruitment process, please inform us here: Talent@Travelopia.com
